def preprocess_text(text):
    """Enhanced text preprocessing with URL removal, Unicode normalization, and accent stripping."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()

    # Remove URLs completely
    text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+|www\.\S+", " ", text)

    # Remove @ mentions
    text = re.sub(r"@\w+\b", " ", text)

    # Unicode normalization - NFKC form
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)

    # Remove non-ASCII letters (accents removed after normalization)
    # But keep numbers and symbols if meaningful
    text = re.sub(r"[\W_][\W_]*", "", text)

    # Remove HTML tags and entities
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r" ", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"&", " ", text)

    # Replace smart quotes and apostrophes
    text = text.replace('"', "'").replace("'", "'").replace("-", "")

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    return text
